step1_analysis.circuit_type: CMOS Amplifier Stage with Bias Network
step1_analysis.description: A common-source amplifier stage with parallel input transistors (XM8, XM9) and an active PMOS load (XM2). It includes a bias generation network (XM1, XM3, XM5-XM7) likely intended for a current-driven bulk (CDB) technique, though the bulk terminals of the main transistors are tied to standard supplies in this extracted netlist.

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the amplifier

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * (ro_n || ro_p). With L=0.5u, the intrinsic gain of a single stage is typically 20-40 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist represents a single stage rather than the full folded cascode described in the paper, so the gain will be significantly lower than the reported 69 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * R_out * C_out). Without an explicit load capacitor, C_out is dominated by parasitic capacitances (~10-50fF).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The bandwidth will be much higher than the paper's 2 MHz due to the lack of a large load capacitor in the testbench and the use of a modern 130nm process.

Power_Consumption.description: Total static power dissipation of the circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_total. I_total is roughly I_XM1 + I_XM2. With VBIAS1=0.99V, PMOS current is ~30-40uA per branch. Total current ~80uA. Power = 1.8V * 80uA = 144uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V supply and the provided bias voltages.

Output_Swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the output node

paper_reported.value: compatible input and output voltage levels

sky130_expected.calculation: Vout_max - Vout_min during a transient simulation with a 0.1V amplitude input.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the exact DC operating point and whether the output node (N4) is saturated or pushed into triode by the bias mismatch.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, -3dB bandwidth, power consumption, and transient output swing of the amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for CMOS Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

XM1 N1 VBIAS1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N4 VBIAS1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N1 VBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 VBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 VBIAS N2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 VBIAS2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N2 N2 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N4 INp N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N4 INn N5 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Voltage Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVBIAS1 VBIAS1 0 0.99
VVBIAS VBIAS 0 0.54
VVBIAS2 VBIAS2 0 0.54
VINp INp 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)
VINn INn 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 1MEG 0 0)

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N4)
meas ac dc_gain max gain_db
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain-3) fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 1n 2u
meas tran vout_max max v(N4)
meas tran vout_min min v(N4)

quit
.endc
.end
